evidence.V1: Front, 3/4 and silhouette read as a bare dead tree, but a visible seating failure (branch butt ends protruding from the trunk surface, see V5) caps this at 1; top view is a clear star of limbs.
evidence.V2: Big tapered trunk and medium curved limbs read, small tier is only 3 thin twig spikes and pale tips; limbs are near-identical horn shapes so hierarchy is only partly there.
evidence.V3: Ribbed flared trunk is nicely stylised, but the limbs are uniform smooth horn/antler curves with needle tips rather than gnarled branches; capped at 1 by the seating failure anyway.
evidence.V4: Trunk has sharp-edged vertical ribs and a jagged flare, while branches are soft smooth tubes with hard flat butt ends; edge treatment is inconsistent between parts.
evidence.V5: Branch joints are not fused: in the fork close-up the right limb's flat butt end sticks out past the trunk silhouette and the upper-left limb shows a hooked stub with a dark concave end; the roots close-up shows a jagged notch crease on the left side of the trunk flare.
evidence.V6: Bark brown in 3 values (dark rib grooves, mid bark, pale tips/heartwood cap); birch and ash colourways stay disciplined.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and bark palette fit, but the kit expects fused smooth organic shells; here limbs are separate tubes with visible butt ends, a mismatch.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Hull collision, CanTouch off, SmoothPlastic, MeshPart.Color white, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Branch butt end protruding from the trunk side at the lower-right limb (fork close-up)
Hooked stub with dark concave end at the upper-left limb joint (crown and fork close-ups)
Jagged notch crease on the left side of the trunk flare (roots close-up)
top_fixes: Fuse limbs into the trunk (boolean union / bridge with a collar) and bury or remove the visible butt ends
Fix the trunk-flare notch on the left side of the base
Make limbs gnarlier and varied (kinks, forks, different thickness) instead of identical horn curves, and add a few more twigs for the small tier
Soften the trunk rib edges to match the branches' edge treatment
